data.long_meaning: Rohini is the name of the 27 lunar mansions, one of which is considered to be auspicious. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with Lord Vishnu's consort, Rohini Devi. The name symbolizes peace, prosperity, and protection. The name Rohini carries the meaning “Night sky” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Rohini usually hope their child will grow to embody night sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohini total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Rohini is a well-known name in Hindu astrology. It represents one of the 27 lunar mansions (Nakshatras), which is considered very auspicious. The nakshatras play a significant role in Hindu astrology as they influence the characteristics and qualities of an individual born under a particular nakshatra. Rohini is ruled by the Moon god and is believed to bring peace and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, Rohini is also known as the wife of Chandra (Moon God) and is revered as Rohini Devi. She is depicted as a beautiful woman, dressed in red clothing and often holding a lotus flower. Rohini is believed to possess the divine qualities of love, harmony, and tranquility. It is said that Rohini Devi has the power to bestow her blessings upon her devotees and protect them from harm. The name Rohini thus represents spiritual qualities such as peace, love, and protection, making it an inspiring and meaningful choice for a name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rohini signifies the radiant and nurturing energy of the moon in Hindu astrology. It is believed that the goddess Rohini bestows prosperity, happiness, and motherly love upon those who bear this name.

vedic_reference.note: Rohini is a star in the constellation of the same name and is associated with the goddess Rohini, the wife of Chandra, the Moon God, in Hindu mythology.

historical_references.reference: Rohini is the name of a lunar mansion (nakshatra) and represents the constellation of Orion's Belt. It is considered auspicious and is ruled by the planet Chandra (Moon). This nakshatra is also associated with the goddess Mariamma, who is believed to protect childbirth and new life.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India, possibly since Vedic times (circa 1500 BCE or earlier)

historical_references.reference: In Hindu astrology, Rohini is one of the 27 lunar mansions and represents the star Betelgeuse in the Orion constellation. It is considered a fortunate star for marriage and is ruled by the planet Venus. In the Puranic texts, Rohini is also referred to as the wife of Chandra (Moon) and is considered the mother of the moon god's two children, Jambha and Pushkara.

modern_usage.modern_context: Rohini is a Hindu lunar mansion, commonly associated with the star Alcor in the Big Dipper constellation. In modern astrology, Rohini is considered a beneficial and lucky star. In the context of space, the name Rohini has been given to the Indian Space Research Organisation's (ISRO) first fully indigenous cryogenic engine, named after the legendary astronomer and mathematician, Bhaskara II, who was born on the Rohini star. Rohini is also a popular name for technology companies in India, reflecting the modern and progressive connotations associated with the name.
